caption: The drawing depicts a wooden round table with a rustic appearance. The tabletop is oval-shaped and colored with shades of brown, depicting wood grain and texture, along with some visible knots and imperfections. The table has three vertically oriented supports: two solid side panels with softly scalloped edges and a base, both shaded in a reddish-brown hue. Between the two side panels is a central horizontal brace with a large decorative scalloped edge, also colored in a reddish tone. Near the top left of the drawing, there is a separate detailed side view of the table's scalloped wood trim, shaded in red with yellow highlights, labeled as “Side-support for Table-top.” The drawing is contained within a rectangular border, and the signature "Rosa Burger" appears at the bottom right. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Table Hutch Bench or Chair Combination
